adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` change the fallback calendar selection from the prior `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` when `externalCalendarId` is falsy. If `externalCalendarId` is `null/undefined` (as can be the case for existing BookingReference rows), the `.find(...)` predicate compares against `null/undefined` and will not select the actual destination calendar externalId, yielding `undefined`. That can cause operations to target the default/"primary" calendar (or pass an undefined calendarId depending on the downstream call), leaving the real event in a non-primary calendar untouched (or causing the update/delete to fail). This faulty conditional logic is directly visible in the diff.
